title: Image-to-video input corrected for grok-video-pro
summary:
Image-to-video input got corrected, nine community projects joined the catalog, and account upgrades stopped depending on GitHub usernames.

Two fixes updated `grok-video-pro` to accept image input and send the first supplied image using the `image` parameter expected by xAI.

New listings range from an Anki deck builder and a room-design preview tool to a PowerShell interface for image, text, and audio generation. The catalog also lost 473 duplicate old-format rows, retained five apps found only in that format, and regained its table headers.

Spore-to-Seed upgrade checks now use GitHub IDs, so a username change no longer interrupts them. Public-commit scoring now looks back 90 days rather than a year, and the dashboard tooltip reflects the new window. The Keys panel also gained an explanation of App Keys and bringing your own Pollinations account.
